description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-execute-results: the UPDATE ran on a read-mode connection ("Operation must use an updateable query") and the compound statement's later steps were skipped. On a read-write ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5): Connection.Execute of UPDATE K SET T = T WHERE Code = 'a1' (State of the result, Errors read and cleared right after), the row read back; then Execute of "SELECT 1 AS A; SELECT 2 AS B" with Errors read and cleared right after, and the result's State. Asks what the UPDATE returns on a writable connection and what the compound statement answers.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
